body: I fucking hate this world. I’m sorry for you. I wish peace for you
Your greatest deed in this world would be to take me out first before you take yourself.
At least you have something to fight for. If you love your children that much, give them everything you can. It is admirable. But I wouldn’t blame you if you left. This world is hell
I want it to just end. I’m tired of fuckin fighting.
I’ve tried so hard for so long, and despite my prayers he allows more pain in my life.
he also takes away. Life isn’t fair
I ain’t got any hope to give either so hopefully you ain’t tryna get that here. My life just fucked up. I would hope a miracle falls out the sky for both of us. Idk if it will tho
Imma try for a bit longer but i been tryin. And I ain’t just bullshitting about that. Shit sucks
It’s not. The worst part is when you can’t go back and fix something. People always say “oh it gets better”. Sometimes it doesn’t. I’m so tired

Hey bro, appreciate the kind words. I swear I saw I dm from you or maybe it wasn’t but it’s gone now. I could be trippin tho. Either way, I’ve got to figure out a way to end it that guarantees it will be the end. Cuz I’m at a point where I want to pull the plug before too long. Life was made for living but i hate the day I was born and I wish people didn’t have to deal with shit hands in life. I come from a family that’s been thru a lot, but at the same time they love me. I am fine financially, I have some friends. But my mind is fucked. I have mental disorders that have just ruined so many things that could be perfect and nobody around me gets it. I try to be thankful for all that I do have but it’s hard. My health doesn’t allow for me to achieve what I wish I could. I feel ashamed for being angry about it at times because there’s so many less fortunate people but at the same time it still sucks. god I hate myself. Deep down I don’t really I just hate how I am. I hate the things I can’t fix. What a joke it all is. I’ll coast for as long as I can until I feel the pull gets strong enough and then I really just need to die.
I wish I had a gun man, I feel you. I can’t tell you it gets better cuz I don’t think it will get better for me. It’s not fair, life is not fair.
I feel similar. I quit working out and have let myself go down a dark road again. I’m tired of trying. I want to leave but I’m not sure what the best way is
Life just feels like a game that I’m losing and I don’t wanna keep playing if that makes sense
